statement: A source-level comparison of SDL Triton at D9's e0232c5 and later 531acc finds that input report 0x42/0x45/0x47 and battery dispatch remain present in both, but later SDL adds explicit left/right digital trigger-click SDL button dispatch. The D9 revision does not dispatch these two buttons separately. Ordinary rumble in the D9 revision uses SDL_hid_write directly; later SDL uses SDL_HIDAPI_SendRumble. The later revision also accepts short haptic effect outputs 0x81 through 0x85 in SendJoystickEffect, whereas the D9 revision's effect method only sends fixed-size feature reports. These are source differences, not claims of physical BLE output or software runtime acceptance. Triton driver D9 e0232c5 lines 150-235, 598-650 and later 531acc lines 150-240, 593-665.

applicability.revision: SDL e0232c5 (exact D9 earlier runtime) compared with SDL 531acc0; retail controller firmware not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer revision delta relevant to BLE and wired SDL testing; no physical observation, not a Steam client difference.
